faq.sizeA: It mostly depends on your weight and experience. A bigger board is more stable and easier to stand up on; a smaller one is faster and more agile. Each size on the model page shows the rider weight it is designed for. Not sure? Message us and we will help.

lift5-f.tagline: The perfect first Lift — the most affordable way into the lineup
lift5-f.description: The same LCS system and the same feeling of flight as the LIFT5, but with a fibreglass board and an aluminium mast: tougher against knocks and noticeably cheaper. With the inflatable Blowfish, even a first-timer can stand up on it.

features.f1: Fibreglass board forgives hard touchdowns and everyday dings
features.f2: 28″ aluminium mast for smooth, predictable flight
features.f3: Gen5 battery — up to 90 minutes on power
features.f4: Grows with you: upgrade the mast and wings to carbon later

lift5.tagline: The flagship — for first flights and experienced riders alike
lift5.audience: Everyone, from beginners to experienced riders
lift5.description: Lift's most refined eFoil. The battery and mast click into place in seconds without tools, and the direct-drive motor is powerful and nearly silent. With a Blowfish, beginners learn and families ride together; without it, it's a fast board with plenty of room to grow.

features.f1: 2.2 kWh Gen5 battery — about 90 minutes on power
features.f2: Carbon mast and Camber Pro wings
features.f3: Elite hand controller with a colour screen: GPS speed, charge, distance
features.f4: Blowfish compatible — for learning and riding with kids

liftx.tagline: The hybrid: rides like a foil, powers like an eFoil
liftx.audience: Riders who are already confident on a foil
liftx.description: LIFTX is built for waves. A light, narrow board and a folding propeller: motor out, let go of the trigger and keep riding the wave with no drag, like a regular surf foil. The motor can be mounted higher or lower — for waves, downwinders or flat water.

features.f1: Folding propeller: the blades fold flat off power and don't slow you down
features.f2: The whole setup weighs under 22 kg
features.f3: LIFTX battery — about 45 minutes on power

lift5-laird.tagline: Signature series created with surfing legend Laird Hamilton
lift5-laird.description: A special LIFT5: a 5'2 board in hexagonal carbon, narrower than usual for its volume — sharper in turns and more confident at speed and in waves. A limited run for 2026.

features.f1: Board shape developed with Laird Hamilton
features.f2: 64 litres in a narrow outline — easy take-offs
features.f3: Gen5 battery — about 90 minutes on power

liftx-florence.tagline: The Florence brothers' series for downwinders and waves
liftx-florence.description: A 4'7 LIFTX developed with world surfing champions John and Nathan Florence and shaped by Jon Pyzel. Built for downwinders, waves and long open-water runs. Limited run.

features.f1: Shaped by Jon Pyzel to the Florence brothers' brief
features.f2: Sits between the 4'3 and 4'8 — the sweet spot for experienced riders

gen5-battery.tagline: The heart of the LIFT5 and LIFT5 F — up to 90 minutes on power
gen5-battery.description: A wireless battery that drops into the board in one move and runs on a single button. 2.2 kWh capacity in a double-walled IP68 enclosure. The 2026 version is 3 kg lighter than before.

features.f2: IP68 protection and automatic shutdown if water gets in
features.f3: A second battery doubles your riding time per day

liftx-battery.tagline: The compact LIFTX battery — about 45 minutes on power
liftx-battery.description: A light battery of about 1 kWh, enough to get out past the break and back. The 2026 version is another 0.8 kg lighter. Fits the LIFT5 and LIFT5 F with an adapter.

features.f2: IP68 protection and automatic shutdown if water gets in
features.f3: Works on the LIFT5 and LIFT5 F with the adapter

liftx-battery-adapter.tagline: The light LIFTX battery on your LIFT5
liftx-battery-adapter.description: The adapter lets you run the light LIFTX battery on a LIFT5 or LIFT5 F — about 8 kg lighter than the standard battery, adapter included. The board feels more responsive, and the adapter installs in seconds.

features.f3: Requires a LIFTX battery — sold separately

elite-hand-controller.tagline: Premium hand controller with a colour screen
elite-hand-controller.description: A carbon shell, titanium hardware and a trigger you can tune to your riding style. The screen shows GPS speed and distance. Comes with a protective case.

lift-hand-controller.tagline: A reliable hand controller — simple and precise
lift-hand-controller.description: A tough controller with an efficient screen: speed, charge and power at a glance. Pairs with the board over Bluetooth, is rechargeable, fully waterproof and floats. Comes with a protective case.

features.f2: Bluetooth and a built-in rechargeable battery

propulsion-55.tagline: 55 mm motor mast — three mounting heights
propulsion-55.description: A carbon mast with a direct-drive motor: less drag and a surfier feel. Installs with the LCS system without tools and works with both LCS and bolt-on wings.

features.f1: Low Mount — the most stable, for all conditions; stock on the LIFTX
features.f2: High Mount — a balance of control and responsiveness
features.f3: Ultra-High Mount — minimal drag for waves and pumping

blowfish.tagline: An inflatable add-on: easier to learn, more fun together
blowfish.description: Blowfish goes over the board and turns it into a stable inflatable platform — somewhere between a SUP and a dinghy. It makes the first stand-up easier, lets you give a child a ride or head out with friends. Pick the size to match your board.

features.f1: For the LIFT5 and LIFT5 F in 4'4, 4'9 and 5'4
features.f3: The board can carry a heavier rider

beach-wheels.tagline: Wheels for the LIFT5 board bag — across the sand with no effort
beach-wheels.description: Wide low-pressure wheels attach to your board bag, so the eFoil rolls over sand and rough ground instead of riding on your shoulder. Arrives fully assembled.

features.f1: Soft low-pressure wheels — quiet and easy on sand

battery-backpack.tagline: A backpack for carrying the battery
battery-backpack.description: The battery weighs 7.6 to 13.8 kg, and carrying it to the water by hand is awkward. The backpack puts the weight on your shoulders. Available for Gen5 and LIFTX.

features.f2: Weight on your shoulders, not in your hands

Tandem.metaTitle: Tandem eFoil ride in Nha Trang
Tandem.metaDescription: Ride together with an instructor: easy, fun and safe. No experience needed.
Tandem.title: Tandem flight
Tandem.text: A tandem is the simplest way to feel what flying an eFoil is like. The instructor picks you up at the pier, and a moment later you are enjoying the freedom of flying above the water. No training needed.
Tandem.heroAlt: A guest and an instructor flying together on one eFoil above the sea

promises.safeText: The instructor is with you throughout the whole flight.
promises.easyText: You do not need to know how to ride — we do it all for you.

steps.gearText: On the beach you are given all the gear you need and prepared for the flight.
steps.tandemText: The instructor flies the foil, you enjoy the ride. Nothing complicated, no requirements.

Training.metaDescription: No experience needed: you'll be up on the wing in your first lesson. Gear, vest and radio included.
Training.heroAlt: Two people flying eFoils above the sea in Nha Trang
Training.lead: No experience needed. You will be up on the wing in your very first lesson.

marquee.success: 90% get up on the wing in their first lesson

Training.includedList: eFoil, life vest, helmet, radio, special gear.
Training.safeBay: Every lesson takes place in a safe, sheltered bay.

steps.briefingText: The instructor shows you every position you will need, on a real board. Then you are fitted with gear and sent out on the water.
steps.lyingText: You start by getting used to the throttle and to the speed of the foil. This stage takes only 5–7 minutes.
steps.balanceTitle: On your knees, then on your feet
steps.balanceText: Same speed, but now you work on balance and on feeling the board. The instructor stays with you through an earpiece.
steps.flightText: The board lifts above the water, the drag disappears and you feel real freedom. You take off on your knees first, then practise flying standing up.

experience.a: No. An eFoil is easier than it looks: 90% of our students are riding in their first lesson. No surfing, wakeboarding or SUP background required.

safety.a: Yes. You wear a life vest for the whole lesson and the instructor is in touch with you the entire time. Speeds during training are low, the boards are stable, and falling into the water does not hurt.

gear.a: Just your swimwear. We provide everything else: vest, helmet, radio contact on the water and special clothing.

lessons.q: How many lessons until I can ride on my own?
lessons.a: After the basic lesson you get access to solo rental and to the minutes package.

age.a: The kids programme runs from 8 to 14. From 15 it is the adult programme, with no upper age limit. Weight limits: 40 to 130 kg.

doubt.q: What if I cannot do it?
doubt.a: You can. 90% of our students ride in their first lesson. The equipment is professional, which makes learning easy, and an experienced instructor stays in contact with you from the shore the whole time.

needTraining.q: Do I need a lesson before buying a package?
needTraining.a: You can buy the package straight away. If you have never ridden before, the first 60 minutes of it are a lesson with an instructor: we do not send anyone out alone without one.

minutesLife.q: How long do the minutes last?
minutesLife.a: 3 months from the date of purchase. They are spent as you ride: 15 minutes a day, or hour-long sessions at the weekend — up to you.

worth.q: How much cheaper is a package than paying per ride?
worth.a: A minute in a package costs about 40% less than in single rental. The package pays for itself by your fifth ride.

tours.q: Who gets to join an excursion or a safari?
tours.a: Riders who are confident on the board. The instructor makes the call: these are trips of several hours into the open sea, and we do not take beginners. No separate package is needed for them.

membership.q: What does club membership give me?
membership.a: Membership is activated by your first package and stays with you for good. It means access to the club Telegram channel, trips out with the team and riding alongside people who are already solid on the wing.

where.a: Our base is Maryna Beach Club in Nha Trang, in a sheltered bay. Trips start from there too: Turtle Island, Monkey Island and the wild beaches.

polina-ch.text: I am incredibly grateful to this team for the chance to try an eFoil. These guys are true professionals! Those 60 minutes had everything: clear theory and plenty of practice on the water. I was scared at first, but the instructor kept encouraging me, explained everything calmly and gave me confidence. I am back in Russia now, but I still live off the memories of that lesson. It was one of the brightest moments of the whole trip!

artem-s.text: The whole family got a wonderful shot of adrenaline. The instructors are great, they explained and showed everything in detail! If it is your first time — definitely take an instructor. The instructor has a microphone and headphones, there is an earpiece built into your helmet too, and he guides you the whole way. The result: a pile of impressions, every member of the family managed to stand up and ride, and some of us even got to fly above the water. I will absolutely be back!

evgeny-k.text: Today our 7-year-old daughter tried riding a hydrofoil board for the first time. We were a little nervous, but our worries vanished straight away. The instructor explained everything in detail, fitted her out completely (life vest, helmet) and watched over every moment himself. She was a bit wary at first, and a minute later she was flying above the water. Her eyes were shining afterwards. We will definitely do it again!

anna-l.text: Guys, thank you for a brilliant experience! My husband loved it — he had wanted to try this for ages and did not regret a second. I want to mention the online booking too: it is great when everything is set up properly for the customer. I hope to come back and try it myself.

polina-sch.text: This is the best thing that could have happened to us on the last day of our holiday! Do not repeat our mistake — start learning as soon as you land in Nha Trang! These guys are first-class instructors. My husband and I both flew on the first attempt, and our 9-year-old son flew too: on his knees the first time and standing up the second. Unforgettable, and worth every dong we paid!

ilya-ya.text: Great guys! Everything people write in the reviews is true. Everything is clear, well explained, no fuss. After that it is down to your own ability! I managed to feel what flying above the water is like. Indescribable! Definitely worth trying if you love extreme sports.

yulia.text: We were staying at Marina Beach, our daughter saw an eFoil and wanted to ride. The instructor Denis found the right approach with her immediately, and she was absolutely delighted with the board — she asked to go again for the rest of the holiday. Thank you so much for the chance to give children unforgettable feelings, flying above the water!

eduard-r.text: Today I tried to stand up on an eFoil for the first time in my life, and I managed it thanks to the clear instructions from Nikolay. Thank you very much for a sea of emotions.

xonder.text: My first time on an eFoil. Under the careful guidance of the instructor Evgeny, who explained everything calmly and gave clear instructions, I managed to stand up and ride. I came away with so many impressions. Really great, and worth the money.

khuong-anh.text: Fantastic efoil spot with attentive and welcoming staff. The peaceful vibe of the beach and Gulf scenery really highlighted my time there.
